cantConnectHint: Check your internet and try again.
replaced: This call is open in another tab.
inAppBody: Calls don't work inside this app.
deniedIos: Tap “aA” › Website Settings › allow Camera and Microphone. Then reload.
deniedAndroid: Tap the icon left of the address › Permissions › allow Camera and Microphone. Then reload.
deniedDesktop: Allow camera and microphone from the icon in the address bar, then reload.
mediaError: Camera or mic is busy. Close other apps and try again.
unsupported: Please open this in Safari or Chrome.
captionsUnavailable: Captions are down. You can still talk.
installIos: Install: Share › Add to Home Screen
captionsCheck: What they read when you talk
weakNetwork: Weak connection. Switch to audio only?
theyCantSeeYou: They can't see you. Restarting camera…
theyCantHearYou: They can't hear you. Reconnecting mic…
cameraFailed: Camera didn't start. Audio and captions still work.
consent: Calls are never recorded. Speech is processed only to make captions.
inRoomOff: Tap if you're in the same room
shortcuts: Keyboard: M mute · V camera · T transcript · Esc close
styleSteadyHint: Only settled words, phrase by phrase. Calmest to read.
styleInstantHint: Fastest: a faint preview of what they're saying, then settled words that don't change.
voiceFocusHint: Only my voice is captioned, not people talking further away.
deniedApp: Open Settings › Simpatico and allow Camera and Microphone, then come back.
isAway: {name} left the app for a moment and can't hear you.
selfSize: Your camera. Tap to change size, drag to move.
profileIntro: Simpatico remembers you on this phone, so calls start faster and captions get your words right.
fromHint: Your accent and slang, e.g. Australian English. Not where you are right now.
wordsHint: Family, friends, pets, teams, places or nicknames you say a lot. Captions will spell them right.
topicsHint: Optional: every call can be about anything. This just helps with words you use a lot.
profilePrivacy: Saved only on this phone. During a call it helps the translator, then it's forgotten. Calls are never recorded.
clearConfirm: Clear your name, gender, words and settings from this phone?
transferHint: Open this link or scan the code on your other phone to copy your profile there. It goes straight between your phones, not through our servers.
importTitle: Copy this profile to this phone?
importBody: This replaces the profile on this phone with {name}'s from the other phone.
myLinkHint: Share it once with someone you call often. Whenever you both open it, you're in a call together: no new link each time.
inviteText: {name} invited you to a video call on Simpatico. Tap to join: no app needed, and you'll see captions in your language.
inviteTextAnon: You're invited to a video call on Simpatico. Tap to join: no app needed, and you'll see captions in your language.
myLinkShort: Share it once. Open it any time to call — no new link needed.
recentHint: Tap to call · hold for details
callPersonHint: Opens your call room and sends {name} a “Join me” message in their language.
clearWhat: Your name, photo, gender, words, caption settings and Recent list will be removed from this phone.
clearNewLink: Also give me a new call card
clearNewLinkWarn: Your old call card will stop reaching you. Anyone who has it will need the new one.
photoHint: People you call see your photo in their Recent list. It goes straight from your phone to theirs, never through our servers.
permBody: Simpatico needs your camera and microphone for the call. Your phone will ask you next: tap Allow.
mediaOffBody: You can still join: you'll see and hear them and read their captions. Turn yours on any time.
micBlocked: Your phone is blocking the microphone.
cameraBlocked: Your phone is blocking the camera.
peerNoMic: {name} hasn't turned on their microphone yet.
micOffTap: Your microphone is off. Tap Mic to turn it on.
waitingPush: {name} is waiting for you. Tap to join.
notifyHint: When someone opens your call card, or one you've joined before, your phone lets you know.
notifyNeedsHome: On iPhone, add Simpatico to your Home Screen first: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
notifyBlocked: Notifications are turned off for Simpatico in your phone's settings.
a2hsTitle: Put Simpatico on your Home Screen
a2hsBody: Open it in one tap, and get told when someone's waiting for you.
a2hsIos: Tap Share at the bottom, then “Add to Home Screen”.
a2hsAndroid: Tap ⋮ at the top, then “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”.
crashBody: Sorry about that. Your call details are safe: tap below to pick up where you left off.
callPairHint: Starts your call with {name}. They're told you're waiting.
learnTitle: Help it hear you next time
learnHint: Names from this call. Tap to save them, so they're heard and translated right next time.
learnHintNone: Did it get a name or word wrong? Add it, so it's heard and translated right next time.
learnPlaceholder: A name or word it got wrong
learnPrivacy: Picked out on this phone from the captions. Nothing from the call is saved.
moveTitle: Move to a new icon or phone
moveHint: Copies everything Simpatico keeps on this phone: your profile and saved words, photo, call card, Recent and the rooms you share with people, and your settings.
moveCopied: Copied. Now open Simpatico where you want it (the new icon, or another phone), go to Me, and tap Paste my data.
movePasteHint: Copied everything from your old icon or phone? Paste it here.
moveBad: That doesn't look like Simpatico data. Copy it again on the old one.
movePreview: Found: {name} · {people} people in Recent · {words} saved words
moveReplaces: This replaces anything Simpatico has saved here.
moveDone: All moved. Turn notifications on again here, then you can delete the old icon.
moveNew: Moving from an old icon or another phone? Bring your data
longScrollHint: Two lines that move up at reading pace. Nothing leaves before you've read it.
longRoomHint: Same-size text in a box that stays still. Scroll up to read back through long speech.
blockHint: They can't reach you and you won't see them. Undo any time on the Me page.
personUnavailable: This person isn't available right now.
mediaTooBig: That's too big to send (videos up to 100 MB).
mediaBadType: That kind of file can't be sent. Try a photo or video.
mediaOffline: Not connected right now. Try again in a moment.
mediaKept: Only kept while the call is on.
ipIntro: Put the phone flat between you. You read the bottom half, they read the top. Nobody needs to tap anything: Simpatico hears who's talking.
ipDetectSub: Simpatico works out their language from what they say.
ipMicBlocked: Simpatico needs the microphone for this. Allow it in your browser settings, then try again.
ipUnavailable: Translation isn't available right now. Try again in a moment.
ipStartTalking: Start talking. What they say will appear here.
ipThemHint: Speak in your language. What they say appears here.
genderWhy: Only so translations use the right words for you.
meGroupWordsSub: Helps captions spell and understand what you say
meGroupDataSub: Move to a new phone, or clear everything
contactsEmpty: No one yet. People appear here after your first call with them.
how2Sub: They tap it. No app or account needed.
how3Sub: Each of you reads the other, translated live.
